|lore=It was hard to imagine the enormous losses the Alliance suffered during the Battle of Hoth. Leia contemplated what she could do to help the Rebellion recover.
|game_text=Deploy on Rebel leader Leia. She is defense value and immunity to attrition +1. While at a battleground, Force drain +1 here and, whenever you initiate a battle with a Rebel of ability &lt; 5, retrieve 1 Force (2 if Leia and an Imperial participating). Lost if a Jedi 'communing.' [Immune to Alter].
